title: Byte Engine image import settings
description: Optional source-image settings for .png and .exr assets.

$schema.description: The local JSON Schema reference for this asset.

image.description: Which optional processing steps the image gets. A key left out keeps the default for the image's semantic.

mips.description: Whether the image stores a full mip chain. Defaults to true. Set false for images drawn at their authored size, such as UI art.

compression.description: Whether the image is block-compressed: BC5 for normal maps, BC7 otherwise. Defaults to true for albedo and normal maps and false for every other semantic. Packed metallic-roughness maps and half-float images are never compressed.
